个别车辆把模块安装到右侧后，开1个小时车速度可能累计增加了5km/h？
由于默认0.1秒时间间隔太短，操作速度太快，个别车机系统可能只识别到减1，或者只识别到加1，不能完整的识别到先减1后加1。

en: : the time from the automatic wheel -1 to the next +1.

If the module is installed on the right speed wheel, set it to 0.5 seconds.
On some cars with the module on the right side, the speed can increase by 5km/h in total after 1 hour of driving. Why?
The default gap of 0.1 seconds is too short, so the action is too fast. Some car systems detect only the -1 or only the +1. They do not detect the full -1, then +1.
Increase the gap. We recommend 0.5 seconds.

How Tesla searches for the 4G network:
: the car checks 1 time every 30 seconds if the SIM card is online. If you turn off the SIM card, the car goes
: the car checks if the SIM card is online in cycles of 5 checks. The first 4 checks are 2 min 30 s apart. The 5th check is 32 min 30 s later.
If you turn on the SIM card during the first 4 checks, the car finds the signal within 2 min 30 s at most.
If you turn on the SIM card during the 5th check, the car finds the signal within 32 min 30 s at most.
